description:
Find a brand's Wikidata entity, the URLs for Organization.sameAs (Wikidata, Wikipedia, X, LinkedIn, Crunchbase, GitHub, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram), its official site and its Google Knowledge Graph entity.

Billing: free — public APIs, no LLM tokens.

When to call: before writing Organization schema (wp_set_organization_schema), Article.publisher or Product.brand. Always pass domain.

Strict match: found:true only when the entity's Wikidata official website matches domain, or you pin qid. Otherwise found:false, same_as [] and candidates: never use a candidate's URLs unless the user confirms it's their brand (then call with its qid). google_kg follows the same rule; google_kg_status not_confirmed ≠ no entity; unavailable: conclude nothing.

Returns { found, domain_matched, matched_by, wikidata_qid, label, official_site, same_as, detail: {wikipedia_url, twitter, linkedin, crunchbase, github, youtube, facebook, instagram}, candidates, google_kg | null, google_kg_status: matched|not_confirmed|unavailable, site_same_as?: [{url, resolves}] (the homepage's own sameAs, checked live; resolving ones are safe to keep), next_step? }.

brand.description: Brand name to search for, as written in prose.

domain.description: The brand's homepage domain (e.g. moz.com). Needed for found:true unless qid is given.

qid.description: Pin a Wikidata item the user confirmed is their brand, e.g. Q48818116.

name: discover_brand_entities
title: Look up a brand's authoritative entity record on Wikidata and Google's Knowledge Graph
